$$

   $$

   $$
   Kiwango ya $x$ kwa $y = 120$ ikiwango 29.25.

   $$
   250 = 4x + 3
   $$
   $$
   4x = 250 - 3 = 247
   $$
   $$
   x = \frac{247}{4} = 61.75
   $$
   Kiwango ya $x$ kwa $y = 250$ ikiwango 61.75.

- $x = 25$ kwa $y = 103$
- $x = 75$ kwa $y = 303$
- $x = 29.25$ kwa $y = 120$
- $x = 61.75$ kwa $y = 250$
